entries.content:
You were right: card creation bypassed the commit batcher. I changed it to queue the new card by its internal ID, so the dialog can close after the card is added locally. The batcher writes and pushes it later, and edits made before the first flush join the same commit.

The relevant tests pass (**123/123**), as do type checking and lint. If the later write fails, the card remains in the pending batch for retry.
